name: Root Samples
label: Quest
description: Root Samples: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The herbs of the Barrens are not quite like herbs in other lands. Their properties are mostly the same, but the oasis water here alters the plants; they are just slightly different.
I want to study those differences... To see if they're exploitable!
If you are skilled in herbalism, then gather root samples off the herbs you find in the Barrens. Bring back these samples so that I may compare them with herbs from other regions.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Hello, friend. Did you get those root samples?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Yes yes, these are very nice! I will grow specimens from these roots and study them. I hope to find new properties from them. Hidden, valuable properties...!
And don't worry -- if I do then you'll be the first to know. Because I'll need someone to gather more!
